newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SAKU RESISTS NEW DISCLOSURE RULES - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: SAKU RESISTS NEW DISCLOSURE RULES - REPORT.

text.p: Saku brewery does not see a need to change its information provision policy ahead of the new disclosure requirements set by the Estonian bourse, Saku's chairman, Cardo Remmel, said in the newspaper Aripaev on Monday.
"We have in-house regulations to provide financial information after eight months and at the year-end," Remmel was quoted as saying in Aripaev.
New regulations for free market listed companies will come into force on June 5. The regulations require free market companies to release quarterly financial information to the bourse.
Companies that have not released their results will face suspension on June 5.
